description: Actor Raja Bundela lauded Amitabh Bachchan's unwavering discipline, recounting an incident where Big B ensured a Goa shoot proceeded despite forgotten continuity shoes. description: A 72-year-old passenger on an Indigo flight from Ghaziabad to Chennai tragically passed away mid-air. The aircraft made an emergency landing in Nagpur where medical teams were prepared. description: In a troubling incident at Bengaluru's Kempegowda International Airport, a South Korean businesswoman reported being sexually harassed by a member of the airline's ground-handling team. description: The ICC has rejected Bangladesh's plea to shift T20 World Cup matches from India to Sri Lanka, citing no credible security threats. description: Meta's new AI Superintelligence Labs has reportedly delivered promising AI models internally, six months into development. title: AI war: Meta resolves issue that enraged Zuckerberg; sparked $15 bn talent hunt push

author: SANDEEP RAI
description: Bodies of a 24-year-old man and an 18-year-old woman from different communities, who had been missing for three days, were discovered in Moradabad district. Police suspect honour killing, with the woman's brothers arrested for allegedly killing the couple and burying their bodies near a temple.
title: Honour killing in Moradabad? Interfaith couple thrashed to death; girl's brother held
